steps.note: Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event card on the vendor dashboard and remain on Event Overview.
Record the vendor's participation choice before entering the Technical Stage.
Open the Technical Stage response questionnaire.
Choose a vendor response option for the technical questionnaire.
Fill the available vendor assessment and line-item specification fields using the portal's supported quick-fill action.
Submit the completed Technical Stage response.
Verify the vendor portal shows the known submitted confirmation state.
Return to the buyer console to verify the response was recorded.
Verify the buyer's Technical Stage Responses view contains the vendor response for evaluation.
